source_snapshot.procedure: Operator inserts USB key; copy a file to/from it, check speed and repeat on all USB3 ports.
source_snapshot.criteria: Copy succeeds, speed is reasonable, but says all USB2 ports should match USB3 speed.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL one-way overwrite/hash with no timing or per-port proof.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adds media/port safeguards but lacks a full timed bidirectional contract and preserves the USB2/USB3 conflict.

old_problem: Master item/procedure require all USB3 ports, while Criteria3 requires USB2 ports to match USB3 speed; port population, dedicated media, bidirectional integrity/timing, cache policy and payload thresholds are also absent.
disposition_reason: USB2 cannot generally satisfy USB3 signaling-rate expectations, so the explicit source conflict cannot be repaired by assumption. ED-15 also forbids PASS without sustained read/write thresholds. A safe parameterized procedure exists, but final acceptance and port scope remain Pending until the Master conflict is authoritatively resolved.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row153, same-row AI fields and history2539; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved copy-to, copy-from, speed measurement and every USB3 port coverage.
Separated negotiated generation from payload throughput and required durable three-way integrity hashes.
Protected all storage/data by dedicated serial-bound media and unique paths; no write, mount, cache drop or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Per-port USB3 bidirectional integrity and sustained throughput
test_case.purpose: On every authoritatively required external port, prove safe bidirectional file integrity and acceptable durable payload rate using dedicated test media.
required_package: Corrected USB2/USB3 required-port matrix and physical root-hub mapping
Dedicated disposable drive serial/partition/filesystem/mount and unique empty test directory
Approved incompressible file size, free-space margin, timing/sync/cache method
Per-port expected negotiated generation and separate sustained read/write payload thresholds
Safe unmount/removal plus I/O/hash/kernel-log abort policy
test_case.test_command: For each approved physical port, operator inserts the same dedicated media; verify serial/mount/free space and negotiated topology, create one approved source file/hash, time host-to-media write including durable sync and hash media file, time media-to-new-host-file read-back and match all hashes, capture logs, sync/unmount safely, then move to the next port without retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every required port negotiates its approved USB generation, both timed directions complete above their signed payload thresholds, source/media/read-back hashes match, and no disconnect/reset/I/O/filesystem/kernel error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the authoritative port matrix plus per-port negotiation, bidirectional integrity and threshold compliance. Missing port, wrong generation, sub-threshold rate, hash mismatch, reset/disconnect/I/O error or unsafe removal fails. No PASS is possible while USB2-versus-USB3 Criteria3 remains unresolved.
safety_gate: Use only serial-verified dedicated disposable media and a unique approved empty path.
Resolve device and mount paths, capacity and free space before every write; never use raw/OS/unknown storage.
Include sync/hash before removal and unmount safely.
Do not drop caches or retry automatically; stop on first I/O, hash or thermal anomaly.
expected_evidence: Resolved port matrix and physical/root-hub map
Source/media/read-back hashes and timed durable write/read transcripts
Per-port rates versus thresholds, kernel/storage logs, safe unmount and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On error preserve media and logs, stop further port moves and unmount only if safe. Never overwrite/reformat or retry automatically; owner decides filesystem/media recovery.

source_conflict.reason: USB3 item/procedure conflicts with Criteria3 requiring USB2 ports to match USB3 speed; neither scope nor expected physical capability can be inferred.

blocked.reason: Guarded USB3 evidence can be collected after prerequisites, but the conflict prevents final verdict; this remains RPUC Pending rather than pipeline BLOCKED.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Authoritative USB2/USB3 port scope correction, media/path, file/timing/cache method, negotiated-generation and sustained-rate thresholds.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; DESTRUCTIVE MEDIA WRITE REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Correct Criteria3/port scope and approve the per-port media/performance contract, then revise the record.

external_authorities: USB generations define signaling tiers but do not by themselves define storage payload throughput
project_authority: Master correction and project port/media performance specification are indispensable for scope and thresholds.
